'''Caar Damask''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who worked for the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] as middle ranking executive and administrator of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], later as director of the treasury branch, and finally as Co-Chair and [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]], during the 9th century of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] period.<ref name="Caar Damask time">In ''Darth Plagueis'', Hego Damask tells [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], in [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], that he would be "well over one hundred" in [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]], which is contradicted in ''[[The Tenebrous Way]]'', where it is implied that Plagueis is at the very least two decades younger than that ([[Star Wars Insider 130|''Star Wars Insider'' 130]]). From the placement of Hego's childhood in relation to his father's activities, it can be inferred that Caar Damask lived sometime between 200 and 67 BBY.</ref> Caar Damask was a scion of the wealthy and influential [[Damask clan]]; he was the son of [[Hego Damask I|Hego of the Damask clan]], and the father of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], who was named after his grandfather and became the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Plagueis.<ref name="Darth P" />

==Biography==
Caar Damask was born on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] in the 8th or 9th century of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] period to [[Hego Damask I]] of the [[Damask clan]]. When Caar grew older, he took on a primary wife, conceived multiple offspring, and became employed by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. He had previously manifested [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]], but kept his abilities a closely guarded secret. Despite his attempts at concealment, his Force-sensitivity would come to the attention of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Tenebrous]] who happened to meet him in the [[High Port Space Center]] while masquerading as the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] designer Rugess Nome. Caar used his [[Force power/Legends|powers]] to move up the corporate ladder by amplifying his ability to manipulate and persuade clients, but his career stalled once he reached a middle management position.<ref name="Darth P" />

Frustrated that his genius was being unrecognized, Caar accepted an assignment from Muunilinst's [[High Officer]] [[Mals Tonith]] as a personal favor in hopes it would advance his stagnant career. He left his primary wife and children behind to build a new life and career for himself as the mining operations supervisor on the Muun colony world [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. Ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after his arrival on Mygeeto, a lower-caste Muun [[Darth Plagueis's mother|female]] would become his assistant. This female had been inserted into this position by Darth Tenebrous who had discovered her Force-sensitivity and taken her on as a disciple. Tenebrous had calculated that a child produced by Caar Damask and his female disciple would be exceptionally strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and would the meet criteria needed to serve as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. After tasking his disciple to seduce Caar Damask, she became his [[Codicil partner|codicil]] wife and bore him a son, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask II]], named after Caar's clan father Hego Damask I.<ref name="Darth P" />

Caar Damask and his wife would raise their son in a domed city on Mygeeto while hiding the secret of their family's powers. Hego's mother was more present for his early development than his father, but Caar still managed to find time to show his son love and attention despite his demanding work schedule. Caar would meet with many important visitors including [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] who visited Mygeeto in search of [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan]] crystals used in [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] construction. Before Hego turned five, he used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince a playmate he didn't like to commit suicide by jumping out a high window. While Hego had been becoming a part of Caar's life more and more, his father thought of him as a monster after this event and began to grow distant. Following the manifestation of Hego's Force-sensitivity, Darth Tenebrous (in his public persona Rugess Nome) travelled to Mygeeto to broker a deal with Caar. In exchange for his lifelong dream of advancing his career into the upper echelon of the InterGalactic Banking Clan, Caar gave up his son to Tenebrous.<ref name="Darth P" />

Five years after Tenebrous' visit, Caar was recalled to Muunilinst to become the director of the treasury branch of the InterGalactic Banking Clan. He returned to his primary wife and children after his codicil wife mysteriously vanished. Many years after Hego Damask began his tutelage under his new master, he returned to his father. Darth Plagueis later claimed to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that he had travelled to Muunilinst as a young adult to live with his father and meet the rest of his clan. As the son of Caar Damask's codicil wife, however, he was never accepted by his half-brothers and sisters, who saw him as an interloper and sought to have him disinherited. Soon afterwards, Caar fell gravely ill at a relatively young age for a Muun, and it was discovered that he had a rare congenital defect in his [[Heart/Legends|tertiary heart]]. On his deathbed, Caar told Hego that he shouldn't hesitate to use whatever means necessary to protect his interests. When Hego's siblings and clan mother learned they had also inherited the defect, they spent millions of credits on a [[Geneticist/Legends|geneticist]] to help cure the condition. Plagueis, having been born to a different mother, did not carry the gene and had hired the geneticist to conduct phony treatments. He took pleasure in his siblings' early deaths, inheriting Caar's wealth they had tried to deny him. Plagueis later admitted to Palpatine that only some of his story was true.<ref name="Darth P" />

Plagueis' inheritance included ownership of [[Sojourn (moon)|Sojourn]], a moon used by the InterGalactic Banking Clan as a place for their wealthiest clientele to relax. Under Caar Damask's management, Sojourn was transformed into a meeting place for the most important players in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to exchange ideas. The think tank founded by Caar established the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]], proposed the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|chancellorship]] of [[Eixes Valorum]], and reorganized the makeup of the [[Trade Federation Directorate]].<ref name="Darth P" />
